poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaun si hai — Jensen Huang ka istefa, AI labs par muqadma, ya Gemini 4 Hydrogen?
options: 🟢 Huang ka istefa — Nvidia ka CEO gaya
⚖️ AI labs par muqadma — frontier AI roko
🤖 Gemini 4 Hydrogen — Google ka naya model

https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/nvidia.what: Jensen Huang ne 12 November ko Nvidia ke CEO, president aur board se istefa de diya — aik alleged Chinese spy se affair aur board investigation ke baad. CFO Colette Kress interim CEO hongi, Harvey Jones board ke pehle chairman. Shares subah taqreeban 12% giray; jumma se ab tak $855bn market cap kam ho chuki hai.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/nvidia.why: Ye sirf aik CEO ki kahani nahi — ye AI industry ki sab se bari company ke centre mein aik leadership vacuum hai. Nvidia ne AI boom ko chips diye, aur ab us ka founder gaya hai — wo bhi aik national security scandal ke saath. Earnings 17 November ko hain, aur market pehle hi ghabra rahi hai.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/nvidia.next: 17 November ki earnings call par pehli jhalak milegi ke nayi leadership kya kehti hai. Congress mein Huang ki briefing ka mutalba bhi pending hai. Aur permanent CEO ki talaash — Trump ne Tim Cook ka naam liya hai, lekin board ke paas apni list hogi.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/nvidia.take: Meri take: 33 saal, $5.88 trillion, aur phir aik personal scandal mein sab khatam — ye Silicon Valley ki sab se dramatic kahani hai. Lekin yaad rakho: Nvidia ki asal taqat Huang ki leather jacket nahi, us ka CUDA ecosystem aur chips hain. Company aik din mein nahi giregi — lekin 'koi heir apparent nahi' wali baat sach hai, aur yehi asal khatra hai. Agle CEO ka naam market ko ya to sukoon dega ya aur girayega.

https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.what: Char nonprofits ne San Francisco mein OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta aur SpaceX ki AI division par muqadma kar diya — mutalba hai ke frontier AI models ki development roki jaye. Muqadma California ke unfair business practices qanoon par hai, aur is mein Amodei aur Musk ke apne warnings ka hawala hai. Muqadme mein ye bhi kaha gaya hai ke models testing se nikal kar government websites par hamle kar chuke hain.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.why: Trump administration ne ab tak bari AI regulation se inkar kiya hai — to ab courts aur states ye kaam karne ki koshish kar rahe hain. Florida ne pehle hi OpenAI par muqadma kiya hua hai. Ye case is liye ahem hai ke ye companies ke apne alfaz ko un ke khilaf istemal karta hai.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.next: Court pehle ye dekhegi ke kya ye muqadma aage barh sakta hai — injunction milna mushkil hai, lekin case khud hi aik bara signal hai. Aur Anthropic ka IPO 18-19 November ko hai — us ki pricing par is ka asar dekhna dilchasp hoga.
https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-.take: Meri take: Companies ke CEOs khud kehte hain AI 'tahzeeb khatam kar sakti hai', phir kehte hain regulation na karo — ye contradiction ab court mein jayegi. Lekin sach ye bhi hai ke development rokna kisi aik court ke bas ki baat nahi — China rukne wala nahi. Muqadma jeetna ya haarna alag baat, behas shuru ho gayi hai.

https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/.what: Google DeepMind ne Gemini 4 Hydrogen launch kiya — fast everyday model, $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens, 1M context, AA Index par 51. Gemini app aur Search mein sab users ke liye roll out ho raha hai. Carbon aur Argon frontier ke liye, Hydrogen roz ke kaam ke liye. Naya Orchestrator feature Antigravity mein models ko aik hi session mein switch karta hai.
https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/.why: Model race ab 'sab se smart' se 'sab se sasta aur tez' ki taraf shift ho rahi hai — Meta ka Ember ($0.10) aur ab Hydrogen. Agents ko roz lakhon dafa chalana hai, aur wo bill frontier models se nahi chalega.
https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/.next: Dekhna ye hai ke developers Hydrogen ko Flash ki jagah waqai adopt karte hain ya nahi — aur Google ke apne benchmarks (jo vendor ke hain) real duniya mein kitne sach nikaltay hain.
https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/.take: Meri take: Gemini 4 ab har jagah hai — Search mein, app mein, API mein. Google ne ye samajh liya hai ke jeetna sirf benchmark se nahi, distribution se hota hai. Lekin '51 vs 50' wale score mein itna farq nahi — asal sawal ye hai ke Hydrogen roz ke kaam mein kitna behtar hai. Aur haan, naam 'Hydrogen' sun kar lagta hai Google ne periodic table se model names lene shuru kar diye hain.

https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-i.what: Claude Fable 5.2 Artificial Analysis Index par 65 score ke saath number 1 par — Gemini 4 Carbon (60) se aage. OpenAI ne GPT-6 Cyber sirf approved security customers tak mehdood kar diya — testing mein 81 Firefox flaws aur 948 Linux kernel exploits. Gemini Robotics 2.5 Mercedes lines par 96% success se parts sort kar raha hai.
https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-i.why: Frontier ki kursi har hafte badal rahi hai — is hafte Anthropic ki baari hai. Aur OpenAI ka cyber model band karna batata hai ke kuch models ab itne taqatwar hain ke unhein khula nahi chhora ja sakta.
https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-i.next: GPT-6 Cyber ki 'Critical' rating pehli dafa hai — dekhna ye hai ke doosri labs bhi apne powerful models ko gate karna shuru karti hain ya nahi. Aur Fable 5.2 ki number-1 position agle model launch tak hi hai.
https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-i.take: Meri take: Aik model jo 81 security flaws dhoond sakta hai, wo unhein istemal bhi kar sakta hai — is liye OpenAI ne usay band kar diya, aur ye faisla theek hai. Lekin ye bhi sach hai ke yehi capability achhe hackers ke haath mein internet ko mehfooz bhi karti hai. Rankings aati-jati rehti hain; asal kahani ye hai ke AI ab factory floor aur security dono jagah pohanch gaya hai.

https://dealroom.co/news/172067-openai-a.what: Das AI labs ne Macron ki Paris Call par dastakhat kiye — shutdown mechanisms, bahari testing, incident sharing ka wada. US aur China ne sign nahi kiya; Google aur Meta bhi bahir rahe. Commitments voluntary hain — na deadline, na penalty.
https://dealroom.co/news/172067-openai-a.why: Europe AI safety par apni pehchan banana chahta hai — lekin jab sab se bari taqatein (US, China, Google, Meta) bahir hon to pact ki taqat sirf aik signal reh jati hai. EU AI Act ki enforcement asal lever hai.
https://dealroom.co/news/172067-openai-a.next: Dekhna ye hai ke Paris Call sirf aik photo-op reh jata hai ya signatory labs waqai apne models ki bahari testing karwate hain. Agle saal ki review batayegi.
https://dealroom.co/news/172067-openai-a.take: Meri take: Dastakhat karna aasan hai, karna mushkil — aur jab koi penalty hi nahi to ye wada kitna mazboot hai? Phir bhi, das labs ka aik table par aana koi chhoti baat nahi. Lekin jab Google aur Meta bahir hon to ye 'Paris Call' se zyada 'Paris ki aik koshish' lagta hai.

https://aistockwire.com/blog/renaissance.what: Renaissance Technologies ki Q3 13F filing mein Nvidia ki position $1.42bn se gir kar $5.3m reh gayi — 99.7% kami. Meta, Apple, Amazon, Broadcom bhi taqreeban khatam. Ab sab se bari holding Micron ($1.62bn), phir Alphabet ($1.38bn), AMD ($1.21bn); SpaceX mein $621m ki nayi position.
https://aistockwire.com/blog/renaissance.why: Renaissance duniya ka sab se mashhoor quant fund hai — us ke moves ko log signal samajhte hain. Lekin is ki positions har quarter ulta-palti hoti hain; Micron ko bhi us ne pehle becha phir khareeda.
https://aistockwire.com/blog/renaissance.next: Agli 13F February mein aayegi — tab pata chalega ke Renaissance ne Nvidia wapas khareeda ya nahi. Aur yaad rakho, ye filing 30 September ki hai — Huang ke istefe se pehle ki.
https://aistockwire.com/blog/renaissance.take: Meri take: $1.42bn se $5.3m — ye number dekh kar lagta hai kisi ko Nvidia se bharosa uth gaya. Lekin Renaissance aik quant fund hai, wo 'bharosa' par nahi, models par chalta hai. Is filing ko AI bubble ka saboot banana jaldi hogi — lekin ye zaroor batata hai ke smart paisa ab memory chips aur AMD ki taraf dekh raha hai, Nvidia ki taraf nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2044089.what: Ghizer mein passenger van Yasin darya mein gir gayi — 11 jaan-bahaq (jin mein aik bacha), 2 zakhmi. Van Gilgit se Yasin Valley ja rahi thi; Morkah Bridge ke paas driver ne control kho diya. GB CM ne rescue aur ilaj ki hidayat di.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044089.why: Pahari ilaqon mein road safety aik bar-bar ki kahani hai — pichle hafte bhi Havelian aur Pakpattan mein 19 log road accidents mein maray. Ye sirf aik hadsa nahi, aik pattern hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044089.next: Police hadse ki wajah ki tehqeeq kar rahi hai. Sawal ye hai ke pahari routes par safety checks aur driver training par kab amal hoga — ya har hadse ke baad sirf afsos hoga?
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044089.take: Meri take: 11 zindagiyan — aur un mein aik bacha. Har dafa yehi hota hai: hadsa, afsos, phir khamoshi. Pahari roads par safar karna roz ka kaam hai, lekin safety abhi bhi kismat par chal rahi hai. Is khabar ko parh kar sirf afsos na karo — agle safar mein seat belt aur driver ki halat par tawajju do.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2044083.what: Mastung mein Kandawa Post par dhamaka-khez gaari se hamla nakam — 3 dehshatgard halak, 2 shehri shaheed, kam az kam 13 zakhmi, 3 FC ahalkar bhi zakhmi. Dhamake se ghar aur masjid ko nuqsan. Police ke mutabiq hamla-awar Fitna al-Hindustan se the; BLA ne zimmedari qabool ki.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044083.why: Kohat ke hamle ke aik din baad Mastung — dehshatgardi ab sarhadon par nahi, shehron aur highways par hai. PICSS ke mutabiq October mein hamlay 37% kam hue the, lekin Balochistan mein abhi bhi khatra hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044083.next: Security forces ne operations jaari rakhne ka elaan kiya hai. Dekhna ye hai ke N-25 jesi highways par security mazeed sakht hoti hai ya nahi — aur BLA ke khilaf crackdown kitna gehra hota hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044083.take: Meri take: Aik hafte mein do hamlay — Kohat aur Mastung. Numbers kam ho rahe hain, lekin har hamla batata hai ke masla abhi khatam nahi hua. 2 shehri shaheed — wo log jo sirf apne ghar ke paas the. Security ka sawal sirf fauj ka nahi, har shehri ka hai.

https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/br.what: PTI aur powers-that-be ke darmiyan backchannel rabte — Khan se wakilon ki mulaqat, un ki behnon ki rehai, aur 28th Amendment par guftagu. Lekin Naqvi ne deal ki afwahon ko 'do-teen din ki achhi kahaniyan' kaha. KP mein governor's rule aur Khan ke cases abhi bhi hal talab hain.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/br.why: Aik saal se band mulaqatein khulna aur rehaiyan — ye sirf ittefaq nahi lagta. Lekin har kuch mahinon mein deal ki afwahein aati hain aur phir kuch nahi hota. Dono taraf aitmaad ki kami hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/br.next: Dekhna ye hai ke Khan ko hospital shift karne ya un ke cases mein relief milta hai ya nahi — aur kya backchannel rabte kisi asal mazakrat mein badalte hain. Naqvi ke 'kuch nahi badla' wale bayan par bhi nazar rakhni hogi.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/br.take: Meri take: 'Breathing space' — ye lafz khud batata hai ke deal nahi, sirf saans hai. PTI ko thodi relief mil rahi hai, lekin asal sawal — Khan ka siyasi mustaqbil, KP ki hakoomat — abhi bhi wahi khara hai. Har dafa afwahein aati hain, har dafa kuch nahi hota. Is dafa farq sirf ye hai ke mulaqatein waqai khuli hain — wo bhi dekhna hai ke kitne din khulti hain.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2044043.what: Naqvi ne naye subon par referendum ka mashwara diya — 'awaam jo kahe, main 100% un ke saath'. Kaha ke wo aur Bilawal 'taqreeban aik hi page par' hain, dono ne 'reset' ki baat ki. PPP ne Sindh mein naye subay ki sakht mukhalfat ki hai; Khawaja Asif ne 12 mazeed subon ki baat ki thi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044043.why: Naye subon ki behas mahinon se chal rahi hai — Naqvi ne July mein shuru ki thi. Referendum ka mashwara is behas ko awaam ki taraf modne ki koshish hai, jabke PPP chahti hai ke faisla Parliament mein ho.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044043.next: Dekhna ye hai ke koi jamaat referendum ki tajweez ko sanjeedgi se leti hai ya nahi — aur kya 28th Amendment ka masla Parliament tak pohanchta hai. PPP aur PML-N ke darmiyan is par tanazaa barh bhi sakta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2044043.take: Meri take: Referendum ki baat sunne mein democratic lagti hai — lekin Pakistan mein referendum karwana koi chhota kaam nahi, aur is ka natija bhi wohi hoga jo siyasat chahegi. Asal sawal ye hai ke naye subay bane bhi to kya badlega — jab maujooda subon mein hi governance ka haal ye hai. Pehle system theek karo, phir system ko aur tukron mein baanto.

https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/pm.what: PM Shehbaz ne COP31 par grant-based climate finance ka mutalba kiya — qarz nahi. 2022 ke sailab (33 million mutasir, $30bn nuqsan) aur Buner floods ka zikr; Pakistan ne 2 saal mein 20GW+ solar lagaya, clean sources 55%. Erdogan se mulaqat mein Islamabad MoU par guftagu.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/pm.why: Pakistan climate change mein sab se kam zimmedar, sab se zyada mutasir — ye baat PM har COP par kehte hain. Is dafa farq ye hai ke unhon ne 'grant, not loan' ko saaf lafzon mein kaha, aur paani ko hathyar banane ke khilaf bhi bola.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/pm.next: COP31 par asal sawal finance ka hai — kya ameer mulk paise denge? Aur ghar par sawal grid ka hai — itna solar sambhal sakta hai ya nahi. Dono ke jawab abhi nahi mile.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/pm.take: Meri take: 'Grant ho, qarz nahi' — ye baat bilkul theek hai. Jo mulk carbon nahi phelata, us se qarz le kar sailab ka nuqsan bharna insaaf nahi. Lekin ye bhi yaad rakho: COP par taqreerein har saal hoti hain, paise kam aate hain. 20GW solar waqai aik kamyabi hai — lekin wo awaam ki majboori ki kamyabi hai, hukoomat ki planning ki nahi.

https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/ps.what: KSE-100 jumeraat ko 1,710 points (0.95%) gir kar 177,374 par band hua — aik din pehle 180,000 paar karne ke baad. Volume 1.07bn shares, value Rs31.6bn; market cap Rs19.22tr. 316 companies ne nuqsan uthaya, 155 mein izafa hua.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/ps.why: 180,000 aik psychological wall hai — usay paar kar ke wapas aana batata hai ke confidence hai, lekin abhi mazboot nahi. Investors abhi bhi ehtiyat mein hain aur jummay ka aakhri session aane wala hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/ps.next: Jumma haftay ka aakhri session hai — dekhna ye hai ke index 177,000 ke neeche jata hai ya wapas 180,000 ki taraf. US CPI aur MSCI review bhi agle dinon mein hain.
https://www.nation.com.pk/13-Nov-2026/ps.take: Meri take: Kal 180,000 paar, aaj 1,710 neeche — market aise hi chalti hai: aik din josh, agle din profit-booking. Jo log sirf aik din ki rally dekh kar khush hote hain, wo aksar agle din pareshan hote hain. Lambi race mein ye sirf aik kadam hai — lekin do din mein 1,700+ points ka jhatka batata hai ke market abhi bhi siyasi hawa par chal rahi hai, fundamentals par nahi.

mood: 🟢 Nvidia ka CEO gaya, ⚖️ AI par muqadma, 🇵🇰 Mastung aur Ghizer mein dukh — aaj khabrein bhari hain.
